career_ladder.note: Supervisory frontline law-enforcement cadre under the Uttar Pradesh Police (Home Department, Government of Uttar Pradesh). Sub-Inspectors are vested with statutory investigation and magisterial arrest powers under the Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita (BNSS) / CrPC. Promotion follows seniority, annual performance appraisals, and departmental promotion boards.

exam_scheme.note: Selection process comprises an Online Written Examination (CBT) of 400 marks across four subjects with section-wise (35%) and aggregate (50%) qualifying minimums, followed by Document Verification & Physical Standard Test (DV/PST) and Physical Efficiency Test (PET).

financial_package.note: Sub-Inspectors in Uttar Pradesh Police are placed in Pay Level 6 (Pay Band ₹9,300–₹34,800 with Grade Pay ₹4,200) under the Uttar Pradesh Revised Pay Rules, 2016. Personnel receive investigation allowance, mobile allowance, kit maintenance, and ration subsidy.
financial_package.pay_source_label: UP Revised Pay Rules 2016 Level 6 & UP Police SI Pay Structure
financial_package.estimate_note: Calculated on Level 6 entry basic pay of ₹35,400 with 58% DA (₹20,532), HRA (₹3,000 to ₹6,000 depending on Class X/Y/Z posting), investigation allowance, kit maintenance allowance, diet subsidy, net of 10% NPS deduction (₹5,593) and GIS.
official_perks: Dearness Allowance (DA) revised bi-annually per UP Government finance orders
House Rent Allowance (HRA) categorized by district classification (Class X/Y/Z)
Diet Allowance / Ration Subsidy for executive officers
Annual Uniform and Kit Maintenance Allowance
National Pension System (NPS) with 14% matching employer contribution
Medical reimbursement under UP Government Servants Medical Attendance Rules
